answer: At each dawn of a new epoch the mesa controller issues a delta‑sized cryptographic puzzle that requires the agent to produce a novel inference trace on fresh data, forcing the claimant to run a full forward pass of its model. The puzzle’s answer is bound to the agent’s public key and recorded on chain, so any duplicate identity must solve a distinct puzzle and cannot reuse a previous proof. An attacker therefore pays the full compute cost of generating a complete model evaluation for every Sybil identity, scaling linearly with the number of fakes.
